relations.text: Procoreは、プラットフォームの運用にAmazon Web Servicesなどの第三者データセンターに依存している
relations.text_en: Procore relies on third-party data centers such as Amazon Web Services to host and operate its platform

source.label: Procore 10-K
source.quote: We rely on third-party data centers, such as Amazon Web Services (“AWS”), to host and operate our platform, and any disruption of or interference with these resources may negatively affect our ability to maintain the performance and reliability of our platform, which could cause our business to suffer.

relations.text: ProcoreとMicrosoftが、Microsoft Azure OpenAI Serviceを用いたProcore Copilotを、顧客が日常使うMicrosoft製品へ広げるため協力している
relations.text_en: Procore and Microsoft are working together to extend Procore Copilot, enabled by Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service, into Microsoft products Procore's customers use every day

source.label: Procore の発表
source.quote: And, two of the construction industry’s most trusted technological partners, Procore and Microsoft, are working together to extend the power of Procore Copilot enabled by Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service, into the Microsoft products Procore’s customers use every day.
source.note: 2023年の発表で、やや古い情報です。

relations.text_en: Nemetschek's Bluebeam announced a strategic partnership with Procore featuring two new integrations
